daily.b: A house is built for you in Paradise for praying them every day.
Remembering Allah at both ends of the day keeps the heart guarded.
Two rak‘at in the forenoon count as charity for every joint of your body.
Close your night prayer with an odd number of rak‘at.
The Prophet ﷺ loved it so much he nearly made it a command before every prayer.
It will come on the Day of Resurrection to intercede for its companions.

daily.t: Sleep on your right side with wudu
daily.b: Go to bed pure and rest on your right side, as the Prophet ﷺ taught.
“Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya” — in Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
Begin every meal with Allah's name so it is blessed.

daily.t: Eat & drink with your right hand
daily.b: A simple daily habit the Prophet ﷺ taught even to children.
Spreading salam builds the love that completes faith.
A smile in your brother's face is written as charity.
Nothing but death stands between its reciter and Paradise.
Recite Ikhlas, Falaq and Nas into your palms and wipe over your body.
The best prayer after the obligatory ones is the prayer at night.

weekly.b: Deeds are presented to Allah on these days — let yours be shown while fasting.
A light that shines for you between the two Fridays.
Come to Jumu‘ah fresh and clean, as the Prophet ﷺ instructed.
Your blessings on the Prophet ﷺ are presented to him — send many on Friday.
Whoever visits the sick is walking among the harvest of Paradise.

monthly.b: Three days each month — like fasting the whole month in reward.
Visiting graves softens the heart and reminds you of the Hereafter.
Keeping family ties brings wider provision and a longer, blessed life.

monthly.t: Reach your Quran target this month
monthly.b: A full khatm or your own juz goal — the Prophet ﷺ advised finishing it in a month.
Extra prayer at night may raise you to a praised station.
